name: Gathered Daybreak
description: Gather a whole daybreak into the palms and hold it ready to fall on a wide patch.

name: Morning Lance
description: Throw a lance of morning light through the strongest guard with the weight of a risen day.

name: Radiant Aegis
description: Hold a ward so brilliant that attackers cannot look at it and their blows lose aim.

name: Dawn Restoration
description: Pour a restoring dawn through an ally to close wounds and burn out curse and poison.

name: Prism Dominion
description: Hold a dominion of crossed colours over the field that burns and bows every foe within.

name: Stellar Pierce
description: Pierce the target with a point of light as hard as a star and as swift as thought.

name: Mirror Eternal
description: Stand in a mirror that gives back every blow and every ray in the strength it came.

name: Aureole Revival
description: Set a great aureole on one whose breath has just failed and bring it back within a short window; the long dead stay dead.

name: First Light
description: Cast the school's first light over the field to burn the foes and show every hidden thing by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Light Eternal
description: Cast the school's lasting light over the allies to mend and guard them by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Endless Day
description: Hold the day open without a dusk until the ground burns away; the scale is the destructive ceiling of a Core cultivator.

name: Origin Light
description: Let the light before any lamp fall so that whatever it touches is shown as it truly is and every false state laid on it is undone.
